body:
# Nemesis 🛠️ 

## What is Nemesis?
Nemesis is a powerful **administration and moderation plugin** designed for server administrators and moderators, providing a comprehensive set of tools for player and server management.

---

## Command reference

### 👻 Utility & stealth commands

| Command | Description | Usage |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **`/vanish`** | Toggles your visibility, making you **invisible** to all non-staff players. | `/vanish` |
| **`/noclip`** | Toggles your gamemode to **Spectator** mode (gamemode 3). | `/noclip` |
| **`/tp <player>`** | **Teleports** you directly to the specified player. | `/tp JohnDoe` |
| **`/tphere <player>`** | **Teleports the specified player** directly to your location. | `/tphere JaneDoe` |

---

### 🚨 Sanctions & punishment commands

| Command | Description | Usage |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **`/warn <player> <reason>`** | Issues a **warning** to a specific player. | `/warn PlayerX Spamming` |
| **`/unwarn <player> <id>`** | **Deletes a specific warning** (by ID) for a player. | `/unwarn PlayerX 3` |
| **`/vwarn <player>`** | **Views the list of warnings** received by a player. | `/vwarn PlayerX` |
| **`/mute <player> <time_in_second> <reason>`** | **Silences** a player for a specified duration (in seconds). | `/mute PlayerY 3600 Insulting` |
| **`/unmute <player>`** | **Unmutes** a player, allowing them to speak again. | `/unmute PlayerY` |
| **`/vmute <player>`** | **Views the reason and remaining time** for which a player is muted. | `/vmute PlayerY` |
| **`/ban <player> <dd:hh:mm:ss> <reason>`** | **Temporarily bans** a player (duration format: day:hour:minute:second). | `/ban PlayerZ 00:01:00:00 Cheating` |
| **`/unban <player>`** | **Unbans** a specific player, restoring access to the server. | `/unban PlayerZ` |

---

### 📢 Communication & alert commands

| Command | Description | Usage |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **`/staffchat <message>`** | Sends a **message to the staff channel** (visible only to staff). | `/staffchat Check report #5` |
| **`/stafftoggle`** | **Toggles your default chat channel** between Staff Chat and General Chat. | `/stafftoggle` |
| **`/alert <message>`** | Sends an **alert message** visible to all logged-in staff members. | `/alert Griefing at spawn` |

---

### 📑 Player report management commands

| Command | Description | Usage |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **`/report <player> <reason>`** | **Reports a player** to the staff team. | `/report PlayerA Harassment` |
| **`/vreports`** | **Views a list of all current reports** submitted by players. | `/vreports` |
| **`/reportlist`** | **Lists player reports.** (Presumed similar to `/vreports`). | `/reportlist` |
| **`/reportinfo <id>`** | **Views the detailed information** of a specific report by its ID. | `/reportinfo 12` |
| **`/delreports <id>`** | **Deletes a player report** from the active list. | `/delreports 12` |
